description: This is a Gradle initialization script written in Kotlin that defines a custom task 'CheckForwardTask' which ensures a root-level 'check' task exists in the project, forwarding it to the ':app:check' task. It is used to standardize the build verification process, especially in CI environments.

classes.name: CheckForwardTask
classes.description: A custom Gradle task extending DefaultTask that forwards the 'check' command to the ':app:check' task, used for CI automation and ensuring consistency in project verification steps.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: A no-operation method annotated with @TaskAction, which is called when the 'check' task is executed. It relies on task dependencies to perform the actual check.
